purpose: Declarative contracts for high-level workflow helper tools that normalize intent and guide task lifecycle actions.

tools.name: normalize_mcp_intent
tools.description: Normalize an agent intent into a canonical MCP request form. Use this as the first stage when the agent is unsure which tool family or endpoint to use.

project_id.description: Optional project identifier for project-aware routing

tools.name: project_workflow
tools.description: Start a thematic project lifecycle workflow from a natural-language intent. Returns step-by-step guidance and a structured form for the agent to fill, instead of requiring the agent to choose several narrow lifecycle tools.

workflow.description: Optional explicit workflow id. Defaults to the first supported project lifecycle workflow.

task_id.description: Optional task id when already known

artifact_key.description: Optional artifact key when already known

tools.name: project_workflow_submit
tools.description: Submit a filled project workflow form. The system routes the structured report to task changes, artifact lifecycle, linked improvements, and evidence records as appropriate.

tools.name: reopen_task
tools.description: Reopen an existing project task. Project is optional when task_id is globally unique; the server resolves it automatically when possible.

project.description: Optional project name; omit to auto-resolve by task_id when possible
